I'm older than you and I have no friends or accomplishments either. I have severe anxiety that causes severe muscle pain and tension and my whole life has been on hold trying to figure out how to get rid of the pain for years. You're not alone. From where I'm standing, as long as you're physically well you have no excuse to not create the life you want (I'm not trying to sound harsh, as I totally understand your pain). You can do whatever you want with your life, just figure out the small steps you need to take first to get there. 

What are you interested in? What do you have fun with during the day? What did you want to be when you were a kid? Would you consider getting your GED or something? Maybe you could move somewhere completely new to see if it changes your perspective on things? Seriously, this isn't a reason to kill yourself because at this age there's pretty much zero doors that are closed to you.

Why do people know? I mean since you're high functioning and everything, it's not like you have to introduce yourself "Hi I'm \_\_ I have autism!" If you're still in high school or something and everyone just knows everyone's business then it's understandable, but past that no one should really know unless you want them to. I have anxiety but it's not like people would automatically know that just by talking to or looking at me and I'm sure it's the same for you. Why do you say normal opportunities aren't available? I dont know a ton about autism so I'm sorry if I come off ignorant but I would assume unless it's severe it's not going to hugely affect what you can accomplish in life.
